dictionary.title: System Options
dictionary.subtitle: Manage all system switches and global capabilities in a single place
dictionary.no_options_found: No options found matching your query
dictionary.opt_music_display_desc: Display an on-screen widget or HUD with title, artist, and cover when a song is playing or recognized
dictionary.opt_music_recognition_desc: Automatically identify songs playing in the environment using acoustic fingerprinting
dictionary.opt_alarm_system_desc: Activate intrusion monitoring and perimeter protection sensors
dictionary.opt_red_alert_desc: Immediately lock accesses and broadcast high-priority emergency alerts
dictionary.opt_camera_alerts_desc: Send notifications and record video clips when motion is detected
dictionary.opt_voice_listening_desc: Enable always-on microphone to listen for the Nuxiva wake word
dictionary.opt_speech_feedback_desc: Speak assistant answers using synthetic voice
dictionary.opt_mcp_tools_desc: Allow the artificial intelligence to run actions and system tools via the MCP protocol
dictionary.opt_kiosk_hud_desc: Show system status indicators, weather, and monitor widgets on the desktop
dictionary.opt_remote_kiosk_desc: Allows remote PCs on the local network to access and manage the kiosk display and multimedia streams
dictionary.advisory_subtitle: Local network display access and security control (Port 80)
dictionary.advisory_desc: You can enable or disable remote kiosk access from another PC. To ensure maximum system security, this option is disabled by default.
dictionary.advisory_media_notice: When enabled, authorized devices opening the display on port 80 can utilize their local webcam and microphone (both over HTTP and HTTPS).
dictionary.opt_lyrics_overlay_desc: Display synchronized song lyrics on screen in real time
dictionary.opt_vitals_tracking_desc: Analyze sensor and biometric telemetry to detect human presence
dictionary.no_engine_options: No additional parameters for this engine
